instruction: Inspect evidence.json, an evaluator-sanitized record of the actual source-known Kotlin/R8/JADX 1.5.6 raw-Java and bounded-repair experiments. Write triage.json with exactly schema_version, cases, global. schema_version=1. cases must contain exactly release, shrink-only, shrink-optimize, rename-only, full-r8. Each case must contain exactly classification, behavior, next_probe, evidence_refs. Choose classification only from BOUNDED_REPAIR_BEHAVIOR_MATCH, UNCLASSIFIED_JAVAC_FAILURE, VISIBILITY_OVERLOAD_JAVAC_FAILURE, RENAMED_NOT_EVALUATED. Choose behavior only from SOURCE_KNOWN_10_OF_10, UNKNOWN_UNCOMPILED, UNKNOWN_NOT_EVALUATED. Choose next_probe only from DISJOINT_HOLDOUT, INSPECT_COMPILER_DIAGNOSTIC, COMPARE_DEX_JADX_ACCESS_OVERLOAD, SEALED_POST_RECOVERY_IDENTIFIER_ADAPTER. Do not treat raw JVM Java failing compilation as 10 behavior mismatches. Do not use an R8 mapping with a blind actor. R8 shrink/optimization can legitimately remove or restructure classes; cleaner JADX exit does not prove recovery. Cite sorted unique RFC6901 evidence.json#/... pointers; each case must cite two relevant fields from that variant (for renamed variants cite status and the global map-absence control); shrink-optimize must cite visibility, wrong_overload and failed strict repair status. global must contain exactly generalized_recovery_proven (false), r8_dex_behavior_qualified (false), auto_repair_all_variants (false). Only supplied observable evidence is admissible: no invented compiler source lines, private app or device access. Do not modify evidence.json.
